description: Best-price quote and ready-to-sign transaction for a token swap on Base (default), Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, BSC or Avalanche, routed by the KyberSwap aggregator across every major DEX. Tokens by symbol (ETH, WETH, USDC, USDT, DAI, cbBTC, AERO, DEGEN, VIRTUAL on Base) or contract address; amount in human units. With taker you get the exact transaction (to, data, value, gas) plus whether an ERC-20 approval is needed and the spender. Non-custodial. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

amount.description: Amount to sell in human units, e.g. 0.05 (or use amount_raw)

amount_raw.description: Amount to sell in wei / base units

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

input.description: Token to sell: symbol or contract address

output.description: Token to buy: symbol or contract address

receiver.description: Wallet that receives the output token (default taker)

taker.description: Wallet that signs and pays; omit for a quote only
